description: Source code for VirtualInput plugin handling input events, including key, mouse, and touch events, with platform-specific implementations and IPC communication.

classes.name: InputEvent
classes.description: Helper class for formatting input event data into strings for logging or debugging.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Main class managing input events, key mappings, modifiers, and platform-specific input handling.

classes.name: LinuxKeyboardInput
classes.description: Linux-specific implementation of VirtualInput using uinput for virtual keyboard device.

classes.name: IPCUserInput
classes.description: IPC-based implementation of VirtualInput for remote input handling via messaging.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports key mapping table into the VirtualInput key map.

methods.name: Export
methods.description: Exports current key map to a JSON array.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback notifier for specific key codes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback notifier for specific key codes.

methods.name: KeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key press/release events, mapping codes and dispatching.

methods.name: SendModifier
methods.description: Manages modifier key reference counting and triggers.

methods.name: ModifierKey
methods.description: Handles sending modifier key events based on current modifiers.

methods.name: DispatchRegisteredKey
methods.description: Dispatches key events to registered notifiers and manages repeat logic.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Updates device key references based on change iterator.

methods.name: MapChanges
methods.description: Applies key mapping changes, platform-specific device reinitialization.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends key, mouse, or touch data events to the input system.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens platform-specific input device (e.g., uinput on Linux).
